support_alice: Heads-up — customer on Dedicated (org AcmeMobile) reporting SSE stream abort mid-response when switching from wifi -> cellular. They get partial chunks then client closes with code 1006. They attached client logs and server trace id rwd-trace-9c3df. Case CS-9881. Need triage.

eng_jordan: Can you paste the client logs + the server side auth/handshake lines? Which SDK / platform?

support_alice: iOS 16.4 app using our JS EventSource polyfill (sets token via ?token= query param). Repro steps from customer: start stream on WiFi, then toggle hotspot (phone becomes tethered on cellular). Client shows 'EventSource closed (1006)'. Server logs show 401/403 for the reconnection attempt, then 429/502 when client retries. Token TTL is 60s for this customer.

sre_lee: Two possibilities: OS kills sockets during the handoff or token rotation race on reconnect. 1006 = abnormal closure. Do we have the server handshake trace for rwd-trace-9c3df?

support_alice: Pasted relevant server lines: "handshake: id=rwd-trace-9c3df auth=ok" then ~30s later "auth failed: expired token for ip=1.2.3.4". Client shows last emitted chunk 'data: {"id":"msg_123","text":"..."}' then nothing.

eng_jordan: Important note: many mobile SSE/EventSource shims do not resend headers or query param tokens automatically on reconnect. If token rotates during network handoff, the reconnect will fail. Can confirm this behavior on Safari/iOS.

pm_ravi: Short-lived token + polyfill via query param is risky for mobile. Recommend either header-based auth that libs will reattach, or longer session token for mobile. Also provide a client-side refresh-before-expiry flow.

sre_lee: Quick repro I ran locally: used curl -N with a short token and toggled the network; immediately saw the server accept initial connection and later an auth fail on rehandshake. Server did not send final [DONE] because client aborted mid-stream.

support_alice: Customer specifically asked if we support resume / delta fetch so they don't lose work when a stream aborts.

eng_jordan: We don't support stream resume. Short-term: recommend client persist last good event id and re-request with prompt delta (replay last tokens) — not ideal. Long-term: consider adding resume tokens or message ACK semantics.

sre_lee: Operationally we can mitigate: 1) add a small grace window for rotated tokens on SSE endpoints (e.g., accept previous token for +10s), 2) improve logging/metrics for "sse-auth-failures" and tie to trace ids. I'll add counters and a log flag for rwd-trace-9c3df.

eng_jordan: SDK action items — patch JS/EventSource wrapper to: a) use Authorization header where possible, b) auto-refresh token 5s before expiry and pause reconnect until new token applied, c) exponential backoff on 429. I can prototype a patch for the customer to test.

support_alice: That would be great — customer willing to try beta. Also asked for any client-side keepalive recommendations to survive OS handoffs.

sre_lee: Recommend TCP keepalive and periodic application-level heartbeat (send a small comment event or a noop every 20s) — some mobile OSes treat idle sockets as expendable during handoff. Also avoid query-param auth.

eng_jordan: Minimal repro snippet I used for toggling network:
```bash
# repro with curl
TOKEN=shortlived_token_here
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?token=$TOKEN"
# then toggle network on macOS:
# sudo ifconfig en0 down; sleep 2; sudo ifconfig en0 up
```

support_alice: Customer logs: "EventSource closed: code=1006, reason=\"\""
They also show the client attempted immediate reconnect without refreshing token= -> got 401.

pm_ravi: Short-term customer guidance: 1) increase mobile token TTL to 5m, 2) migrate to header auth in SDK, 3) add heartbeat pings in app, 4) add exponential backoff + refresh-before-retry. I'll coordinate docs.

sre_lee: I'll add the sse-auth-failure metric and enable verbose logs for the trace id so we can verify after the customer reproduces. We should also consider a small server-side grace window while we ship SDK changes.

eng_jordan: Patching SDK now. Will post a binary and a small changelog for the customer to try.

support_alice: Thanks — I'll update CS-9881 and send the repro steps + SDK build. Customer is ok to test this afternoon. :pray: 

deploy-bot: Feature-flag "sse-auth-grace" set to ON for staging only. Rolling logs to capture rwd-trace-9c3df.

support_alice: Closing loop — will reopen if customer still sees partial output after test.
